protocol.checkpoint_rule: Fixed terminal Step2000; do not select checkpoints/prompts by this dataset.
protocol.exclusion: Exact RGB or pHash<=6 AND dHash<=6 against all inventoried prior local image exposure; conservatively quarantine candidates before inference.
protocol.text_overlap: Flag repeated spatial captions separately; they are not sufficient to classify image leakage.
protocol.further_clearance: Crop/scene/entity review required. No automatic inference or release.
protocol.image_transport: Original official COCO HTTP image_link; HTTPS has hostname certificate mismatch. Persist byte hashes and image validation; no TLS verification bypass.

scope: Conservative development-disjoint subset candidate, not official full-test score. Review before any formal evaluation.
